verdict.rationale: Linear states it can automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are routed, labeled, and prioritized. Its Customer Requests docs show feedback attached to the issues and projects customers asked for, with requests editable and Slack Asks linked to customers. missing for 10: step-by-step documentation of the actual submission-to-issue/project conversion flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can turn a customer feedback submission directly into an actionable task or project intention

citations.quote: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
Understand customer use-cases directly on the issues and projects they’ve asked for
This request can be edited in Linear to add images, videos, or extra context.
